title: Can I BEAT Passant? [Full Release]
summary: Passant full release, part 1: plays the roguelike from stage 1 (blue/light-blue board), loses early ('Game Over - You made it to stage 1, round 1' with an Undo charge) and continues to a later pink stage.
rules: Passant (Steam chess roguelike): 8x8 board (a-h/1-8); you play White with a small army through stages and rounds of enemy black pieces; clear rounds to progress.
Between rounds: SHOP to buy piece upgrades (e.g. Rainbow Bishop/Rainbow Pawn variants) with money, Re-roll ($2), Next Round; Balance/Money counter.
Boss rounds: boss panel with enemy ability text (e.g. Enemy Rainbow Pawn, Rainbow Bishop); special effects like laser beams down a file.
Undo button with limited charges ('Undo 1 turn (1 remain)'), Recycle button; special tiles such as 'Unstable' and arrow tiles.
Game over screen: 'You made it to stage X, round Y'. Stats: Stage / Turn / Score / Money.
win_condition: Clear all stages/rounds including boss rounds; capture enemy pieces/king each round (exact round win condition not read).

board.theme_notes: blue/light-blue board in stage 1; pink/dark in later stage

custom_pieces.moves: upgraded versions with extra abilities (exact text not read)
